answer: Vote independence is attested, not assumed: each decision is hashed into a per-identity vector over shared assignments. When two identities overlap on twenty or more items and correlate above 0.90, they collapse into one voter splitting a single share, because a farm's clones grade in lockstep from one script. Honest graders disagree on a basalt-hard minority of items, and their vectors drift apart. Independence means a different judge per alias, costing a second model every epoch, so the shale of cheap duplication crumbles at the inlet.
